## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is `feat/<name>` / `fix/<name>` / `docs/<name>` (not `main`)
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`pytest tests/` and/or `pytest brain_v2/tests/`)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, tokens, or personal paths/usernames in the diff
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated if this is a user-visible change
